title: Screening of Key Components for Melanogenesis Inhibition of Polygonum cuspidatum Extract Based on the Spectrum-Effect Relationship and Molecular Docking.
authors: Du, Ruojun; Ye, Lichun; Chen, Xinyan; Meng, Yan; Zhou, Lei; Chen, Qiao; Zheng, Guohua; Hu, Junjie; Shi, Zhaohua
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过HPLC指纹图谱与分子对接筛选虎杖提取物中抑制黑色素生成的活性成分，虽涉及小分子-蛋白对接，但对象为酪氨酸酶而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题TF-DNA结合研究无关。
abstract: Polygonum cuspidatum (PC) extract has been listed in the "Catalog of Used Cosmetic Ingredients (2021 Edition)", which can inhibit melanogenesis, thus exerting a whitening effect, and has been widely used in cosmetics. However, there are currently no quality standards for PC extract used in cosmetics, and the bioactive components associated with anti-melanogenesis remain unclear. In view of this, the present study was the first to investigate the spectrum-effect relationship between fingerprints of PC extract and melanogenesis inhibition. Ten batches of PC extract fingerprints were established by HPLC. Pearson's correlation analysis, gray correlation analysis (GRA) and orthogonal partial least squares regression analysis (OPLSR) were used to screen out resveratrol, emodin and physcion as the main whitening active ingredients using the inhibition of tyrosinase in B16F10 cells as the pharmacological index. Then, the melanogenesis inhibitory effects of the above three components were verified by tyrosinase inhibition and a melanin content assay in B16F10 cells. The interaction between small molecules and proteins was investigated by the molecular docking method, and it was confirmed by quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) that resveratrol, emodin and physcion significantly down-regulated the transcript levels of melanogenesis-related factors. In conclusion, this study established a general model combining HPLC fingerprinting and melanogenesis inhibition and also analyzed the spectrum-effect relationship of PC extract, which provided theoretical support for the quality control of PC extract in whitening cosmetics.
abstract_zh: 虎杖（Polygonum cuspidatum, PC）提取物已被列入《已使用化妆品原料目录（2021年版）》，其能够抑制黑色素生成，从而发挥美白作用，并已广泛应用于化妆品中。然而，目前尚无用于化妆品的PC提取物质量标准，且与抗黑色素生成相关的生物活性成分仍不明确。鉴于此，本研究首次探讨了PC提取物指纹图谱与黑色素生成抑制之间的谱效关系。采用高效液相色谱法（HPLC）建立了10批PC提取物的指纹图谱。以B16F10细胞中酪氨酸酶抑制率为药理学指标，结合皮尔逊相关分析、灰色关联分析（GRA）和正交偏最小二乘回归分析（OPLSR），筛选出白藜芦醇、大黄素和大黄素甲醚作为主要美白活性成分。随后，通过酪氨酸酶抑制和黑色素含量测定实验，在B16F10细胞中验证了上述三种成分的黑色素生成抑制效果。采用分子对接方法研究小分子与蛋白质之间的相互作用，并通过实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）确认白藜芦醇、大黄素和大黄素甲醚显著下调了黑色素生成相关因子的转录水平。总之，本研究建立了一种结合HPLC指纹图谱和黑色素生成抑制的通用模型，并分析了PC提取物的谱效关系，为美白化妆品中PC提取物的质量控制提供了理论支持。
